intended_object: A helper linear map ℂ → (unit module ⊗ point module).even, sending c to the image of c·1 under the base-change map `pointBaseEps`. It is the "raw" form of the unit comparison map ε of the fibre functor at a super point, before the coordinates are installed (from the docstring and how the file uses it).
explanation: The docstring says this is the unit comparison "before the coordinates are installed", so it is an intermediate step in the library's construction. The body composes `LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ S.even S.one` (c ↦ c·1) with the even part of `pointBaseEps P`. The file then proves it bijective (`superVectEpsRaw_bijective`) using `unitTensorPoint`, and uses it to build the actual unit isomorphism of the monoidal fibre functor. The map depends on the library's own encodings (`S.Mod.tensor`, `pointMod`, `.even`). It is a proof-internal building block, not a standard object from the literature on its own, so there is nothing to compare it with for faithfulness or generality.
